create session NAME in the current directory and attach to it

Usage:
  cld new [-n NAME] [-w] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help        help for new
  -n, --name NAME   the session NAME: letters, digits, "_" and "-", starting
                    with a letter or digit (default "main")
  -w, --worktree    run claude in git worktree NAME, which claude creates from
                    HEAD or reopens (claude --worktree NAME)
